_readme: Golden-question regression set for Ask retrieval (spec R6:
This is a SYSTEM regression suite, not per-user calibration: each entry
represents a CLASS of query every user will hit (type-word mismatch,
absent-word FTS miss, single-word lookup, fuzzy recall). Entries are
replayed against a live account's data by scripts/eval-retrieval.mjs,
which mimics the edge function's soft-filter merge. Seeded 2026-08-30
from real production failures; grow it from retrieval_log across
accounts as classes of miss appear — never to tune to one user's
phrasing. expect_item ids are per-account, so entries carry user_email.
Filters mirror what an over-eager agent would send — the suite asserts
the system survives wrong filter guesses.

cases.note: Real failure 2026-08-30 01:48 UTC: 'the book I was making a note of' is a VOICE note (audio). Hard types=[text] excluded the #1 unfiltered hit.

cases.query: how to use Claude tutorial video
cases.note: Real failure 2026-08-30 03:03 UTC: YouTube saves are type=link (flavor video). types=[video] returned only uploaded video files.
'author' appears nowhere in the item; websearch_to_tsquery ANDs terms so the keyword leg misses. The vector leg must carry it.
One-word entries are lookups; title-bearing items must surface.

cases.note: Worked 2026-08-29 (kept as a don't-regress case): photographed store tag, found via OCR/description enrichment.
